run.metric_policy: Corpus CER/WER fractions; lower is better and values may exceed 1. Text is NFC-normalized and whitespace-collapsed; case and punctuation are preserved. Page metrics do not score layout structure.

warnings.message: This MVP run is incomplete. Compare completed results on the same frozen datasets, not averages over different completed subsets.
Repeated generated text was observed. Scores retain these errors; the cause is not yet established, so comparisons remain provisional.
References were extracted from source PDFs, not independently transcribed by humans; extraction and reading-order errors can affect scores.
Samples come from the source dataset's train split; this is not an official held-out test split. This alone does not establish model training overlap.
This model was fine-tuned on the NorHand dataset family. Interpret this pairing as in-domain, not an out-of-domain result.
